description: Capability for the main window and embedded Harness GUI. Security boundary: NO remote URLs are granted Tauri permissions. The shell and pet windows only load bundled local assets (WebviewUrl::App), and the embedded Harness GUI (served at http://127.0.0.1:<port>) is sandboxed inside an iframe that has no __TAURI_INTERNALS__; it communicates with the shell exclusively through the validated postMessage bridge (use-iframe-invoke). The service port is NOT fixed: it defaults to 3080/3081 but is user-configurable and advances to the next free port when the default is occupied (service/workflow::find_available_port).
